Stockfish 19 (tag sf_19), unmodified official release binaries.

Linux:   stockfish-linux-x86-64-universal.tar.gz
Windows: stockfish-windows-x86-64-universal.zip
from https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/tag/sf_19

Complete corresponding source code:
  https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/tree/sf_19
  (also contained in the release archives above, folder stockfish/src)

Stockfish is free software under the GNU General Public License v3 (see COPYING.txt).
It runs as a separate process and talks to the game only via the UCI text protocol.
